description: Defines the QuicCompressedCertsCache class, a cache for storing compressed certificates in the QUIC protocol implementation, including related data structures and methods for cache management.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing and retrieving compressed certificates with LRU eviction policy.

classes.name: UncompressedCerts
classes.description: A wrapper struct to identify uncompressed certificate representations, including a chain pointer and cert hashes.

classes.name: CachedCerts
classes.description: A class representing cached compressed certificates, with methods to match uncompressed certs and access the compressed data.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with maximum size.

methods.name: GetCompressedCert
methods.description: Retrieves cached compressed cert if available for given chain and hashes.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new compressed cert into the cache.

methods.name: CachedCerts
methods.description: Constructors for CachedCerts, including copy constructor.

methods.name: MatchesUncompressedCerts
methods.description: Checks if uncompressed certs match stored certs.
